score_definition: mean(metric / frozen scale), an auxiliary ranking score, not paper composite

fixed_extension_rule.online: separate diagnostic cohort; never substitute online for EMA to improve ranking
order: variant alphabetical only for exact numeric ties
fixed_extension_rule.evaluation_conditions: same seed817, generation seed2817, eval manifest, normalizer, fixed optimizer/calibration/conditioning
fixed_extension_rule.missing_result_policy: Wait for all four targeted 4096 EMA observations before automated selection. If fewer than two eligible non-control candidates remain, report the shortage without relaxing the gate post hoc.
fixed_extension_rule.freeze: No further recipe expansion or score/gate retuning after targeted outcomes. These are adaptive rules fixed for the next stage, not a preregistration of the entire completed sweep.

gate_assessment.reasonable: Yes as a fixed early-training exclusion guard, with all main seven currently eligible. It avoids choosing a low-score result driven by extremely poor vehicle/on-road coverage without altering the loss or auxiliary score.
gate_assessment.limitation: GT on-road fraction is .9939806333420571. Road .72 is only ~72.4% of that conditional coverage; current main EMA roads .74897–.80486 still leave substantial off-road mass. This is not a final acceptance threshold and does not make the lane-conditioned distributions complete.
gate_assessment.coverage_bias: Angle/lateral JSD are conditioned on eligible on-road vehicles. Keep generated and GT on-road vehicle counts and full-feature histogram coverage beside the score. Do not treat the low angular JSD as a guarantee of the correct full-scene heading distribution.
gate_assessment.selection_noise: One training seed and one generation seed can reverse rankings. Small score gaps are not statistically significant without paired independent-seed confirmation. geometry_strong and warm2048 EMA differ by only ~.000006, an effective tie.

forecast_criteria.qualitative_only: Recommend a promising from-scratch recipe, not a numeric128-epoch forecast or proven global optimum.

Online legacy shape JSD rises again by4096 while EMA shape improves, so smooth loss/EMA curves cannot be replaced by extrapolating online snapshots.
128_epoch_expectations: Circular angle L1 has a useful angular signal from random initialization and currently supports the best EMA angle metric; its final advantage is plausible, not established.
Width p2 and heading p2 must be separated: the warm recipe jointly changed both, and its late recovery means1024 scores were insufficient to reject it.

Strong position/collision treatment improves coverage and collision but can trade against angle; geo_mse32_col20 EMA collision1.5877 is best main-seven while its angle7.4562 is much worse than the L1-heading incumbent .8642.
EMA stabilizes scalar distributions across all seven; choosing an EMA deployment recipe requires confirming the same EMA setting at production batch size.
Do not claim that lower early shape JSD means final mode coverage is correct; inspect type counts and physical-size histogram shifts as training continues.

The original batch512 confirmation must state updates, seen scenes, data order, and per-update EMA horizon. Final128-epoch behavior cannot be extrapolated numerically from these sub-epoch stages.

original_batch_confirmation_addendum.recommendation: Prioritize fresh original-batch512 finalists to2048 updates, checkpoints768/1536/2048, before using the remaining budget solely for three sub-epoch replications.
original_batch_confirmation_addendum.reason: Observed first-pass rank reversals and nonlinear curves make a second/third pass more useful for qualitative full-training trend evidence; deeper single-seed runs still require independent-seed confirmation.
original_batch_confirmation_addendum.paired_controls: Same ordered full manifest, seed, optimizer/calibration/conditioning, fixed production EMA across finalists. Full manifest must define real epochs; document any repeated fixed order versus normal per-epoch reshuffling.
original_batch_confirmation_addendum.fresh_only: Allow multiple epochs only for fresh runs until resume offset/RNG/global-epoch handling is explicitly generalized. Do not apply one-epoch offsets or force epoch0 scheduler state across genuine epoch boundaries.
original_batch_confirmation_addendum.scheduler: Preserve genuine completed-epoch scheduler advances; undo only the artificial partial-final-stage step if preserving a continuation-ready checkpoint. Duplicating the full dataset would conceal actual epoch boundaries.
original_batch_confirmation_addendum.confirmation: Add two independent training seeds to the same2048 budget if feasible. If they end earlier, report separate-budget evidence and do not pool their SD with2048 results.
original_batch_confirmation_addendum.limit: ~2.125epochs improves early-trend evidence but is not an empirical estimate of128-epoch asymptotics.
